title: NexGo Rating Standard
description: Schema for passenger-to-driver ratings stored as raw (state register) assets on the Nexus blockchain, used by the NexGo P2P ride-hailing module.

dataFormat.description: Raw format stores the entire payload as a JSON string in the asset's data field. Unlike JSON-format assets, raw assets do not have typed fields -- the data is a single opaque blob that the application parses.

ratings.description: Map of driver genesis hashes to rating entries. Each key is a Nexus genesis hash identifying a driver.

avoid.description: If true, marks this driver as 'to be avoided' by the rating passenger.

naming.description: One rating asset per passenger, local to the passenger's signature chain.

aggregation.description: Multiple rating assets from different passengers are aggregated to compute per-driver statistics.

computedFields.average: Mean score across all ratings for a driver
computedFields.avoidCount: Number of passengers who flagged the driver as 'avoid'

examples._comment: Passenger's rating asset with ratings for two drivers

nexus.queryNote: Fetches ALL raw assets globally. App must parse each asset's data field and filter for distordia-type === 'nexgo-rating'.
